images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a Renaissance museum portal split with a bioluminescent trench observation dome, the thunder-god cosmic warrior hero performs a dramatic wall cling and catches a runaway miniature train beside a cracked glowing rescue beacon. A tiny portal no larger than one white paw explains the precise pose; lightning, wet blue light, flying train wheels, and a museum world split make the event legible. Outcome: the pursued hero was carrying emergency medicine, and the package visibly reaches a small safe medical pod. Include Runaway train interception, the pursued hero was carrying emergency medicine, the portal is no larger than one white paw, wink-like one-eye squint, dramatic wall cling, museum world split, one decisive action, bright, clearly separated suit colors, and no exact costume copy. Safe invisible supports, realistic paw pads, no danger, no logos, no text, no famous artwork, no cartoon or 3D render, no duplicate limbs.
Required assigned visual details: lightning storm; no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
